text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zimbabwe press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zimbabwe is losing about 60,000 man hours, or between Z$30 million and Z$40 million every year through absenteeism, a human resources expert has said.

- Former state president Canaan Banana, facing 11 charges of sodomy, attempted sodomy and indecent assault, has successfully bid in the Supreme Court to have the date for his trial postponed from Monday to a later date to enable him to retain the services of senior defence counsel Chris Andersen.
- At least two people die everyday in Zimbabwe from accidents at the work place with Harare having three deaths at the work place this week.
- Fifty-two people escaped death on Thursday when a bus they were travelling in collided head-on with a light truck and plunged into a river bed in eastern Zimbabwe.
